findings.summary: The provider schema requires at least one finding, strict SGR validation rejects empty findings for every verdict, and focused regression coverage includes pass, rework, blocked, and human_review.
findings.broken_invariant: An evaluator verdict must not be accepted without at least one evidence-backed finding.
